experiments.title: Test a missing resource
experiments.instruction: Predict whether changing light from 30 to 100 changes the activity index when water is 0 and carbon dioxide is held at 80. Run the fixed trials.
experiments.observe: Both trials show 0. Light supplies energy, but it cannot replace water as a matter input.

experiments.title: Find where light stops limiting
experiments.instruction: Hold water at 35 and carbon dioxide at 80. Predict the pattern for light settings 15, 35 and 100, then run all three trials.
experiments.observe: The index rises from 37 to 67, then stays at 67 because water limits the model above light 35.
